name: Life science / lab
summary: Purpose-built lab building: 15–16 ft floor-to-floor, vibration-stiff structure, 100% outside-air HVAC with energy recovery, generator, lab plumbing and gases, delivered with a typical wet-lab fit-out (≈50–60% lab / 40–50% office). Cumming 2025 metro data are the best public source; academic-lab data (RSMeans) run lower. Costs vary 2–3× with lab intensity and market.

typicalSize.method: Judgment: suburban/urban speculative lab buildings 3–6 floors.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Derived: 3–4 story building with 2.5–3 spaces/1,000 SF surface or partly structured parking.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per GSF (judgment: lab occupancy lower than office).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Complete lab building incl. typical lab fit-out and ≈$25–35/SF sitework. Cumming 2025 (excl. sitework) midpoints: Nashville $770, Dallas $855, Boston $1,110 (e1, e2). RSMeans 2022 academic lab median $355 (e3) is a lower-intensity proxy. Mid = $750 ≈ lower-cost-metro Cumming midpoints trimmed toward RSMeans (national mix of markets and dry/wet labs) + sitework. Low = $480 ≈ Cumming Nashville low / RSMeans 3/4 quartile escalated (light/dry lab). High = $1,200 ≈ Cumming Dallas high / Boston midpoint (wet lab, vivarium-ready). Derived blend — verify.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/fee; shell, core and typical lab fit-out (casework, fume hoods, lab MEP); excludes lab equipment, furniture, vivarium, land, soft costs.

systemSplit.method: Derived from RSMeans 2022 academic lab medians (e3): mechanical 19.4% → 23 22% (+25 controls 1%) for 100% OA commercial labs; electrical 12.05% → 26 12% + 27/28; plumbing 3.77% raised to 6% for lab waste/RODI/gases. Lab casework/fume hoods 12 5%, lab equipment rough-ins 11 2%. Sitework 4%.

lineItems.name: Lab HVAC premium over office HVAC (carve-out)

cost.method: From _blocks/specialty-mep.json lab-hvac-upgrade (derived there); qty = 55% lab area share (judgment).
From _blocks/specialty-mep.json emergency-generator; ≈10 W/SF standby (judgment) → 1,200 kW for 120,000 SF.
Derived judgment: vivarium premium over wet lab per SF of vivarium area; default 5% of GSF.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived judgment: office/break furniture and movable lab benches; scientific equipment excluded (tenant).

pctOfHard.method: Derived: A/E + lab planner 8–10%, commissioning 1–2%, permits 1–2%, testing/survey 1%, insurance/legal 2–3%, developer fee 3–5%, leasing 2–4%. | Second pass (2026-10-24, main session): Reduced 4 points to remove the developer fee (3–5%). The engine adds impact & tap fees, the developer fee and construction financing as their own lines (docs/BUDGET_ENGINE.md §5), so this bucket must exclude them.

softCosts.notes: Lab planning and enhanced commissioning raise A/E above office norms.

design.method: Lab MEP complexity; tenant requirements often unknown at shell design.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Min ≈ RSMeans academic lab 3/4 quartile escalated + 20% soft; max ≈ Cumming San Francisco high ($1,600) × 1.25.
